1_AvailabilityService_responsibilities.summary: SSOT for branch-scoped item availability (manual rupture / 86 / auto-quota / extras / variations / cancel-refund release).

key_methods.toggle(item,branch,available,reason): Locked upsert on item_branch_availability + dispatch ItemAvailabilityChanged::forBranch after commit
key_methods.setMaxDailyQty(item,branch,max): Quota cap re-evaluation with auto-86 + auto-restore path
key_methods.decrementForOrder(order): Atomic CAS counter update + idempotent guard `availability:decremented:{kind}:{branch}:{order}` cache (24h TTL — HEAL-C.1 Z2 P1 2026-05-19 commit, fixes double-count if OrderCreated re-fires)
key_methods.releaseForOrderItems(lineItems): Compensating decrement on cancel/refund — idempotent via order_items.released_qty ledger
key_methods.assertItemsOrderableForBranch(branch,ids: Locked SELECT FOR UPDATE serializes with checkout; absent row = available (V1 rule)

concurrency_primitives: Per-order idempotent cache key (SETNX-equivalent via Cache::add) on decrementForOrder
Atomic CASE WHEN counter UPDATE so concurrent decrements all bounded by max_daily_qty
CAS-style flip UPDATE (WHERE is_available=true AND counter>=cap) emits 86 event exactly once
DB::afterCommit guard on every event dispatch (commit-before-broadcast invariant — gate C9 / KI-001)

2_StockService_responsibilities.summary: Numeric stock SSOT (stock_levels.on_hand) — mutates per order/cancel/refund. Drives auto-rupture/auto-restore on Item via syncItemAvailabilityForStockLevel().

key_methods.decrementForOrder(order): Decrement stock_levels.on_hand for item + variations + extras + composition_snapshot.addons; emits ItemAvailabilityChanged::forBranch(reason:'stock_rupture') when on_hand crosses to 0
key_methods.releaseForOrder(order,reason,refundedIte: Symmetric increment with requireOriginalDecrement guard (won't increment without matching order_created movement)
key_methods.syncItemAvailabilityForStockLevel(level,: Mirror layer Item-only — flips item_branch_availability.is_available when on_hand crosses zero; only overrides ENUM auto-rupture reasons, never manual rupture
key_methods.isAutoStockRuptureReason(reason): Recognises both 'stock_rupture' (canonical) and 'out_of_stock' (legacy) — manual reasons preserved

concurrency_primitives: DB::transaction + lockForUpdate on each StockLevel row
stock_movements.idempotency_key UNIQUE INDEX (migration 2026_04_27_143130) blocks double-decrement at DB level
requireOriginalDecrement guard on release path (can't refund what was never decremented)
StockMovement append-only — DB triggers (migration 2026_05_18_140000_add_stock_movements_immutability_triggers) reject UPDATE/DELETE

AUTO_RUPTURE_STOCK_ZERO: StockLevelChanged dispatched if boundary crossed for extras/variations/composition addons
AUTO_RESTORE_REFUND_CANCEL: StockService::releaseForOrder (CAS increment) → syncItemAvailabilityForStockLevel may emit reason='stock_restocked'
AvailabilityService::releaseForOrderItems (counter back-out + restore flip if quota gating)

6_race_admin_toggle_during_checkout.scenario: Customer at kiosk POSTs /api/frontend/order while admin clicks 'mark unavailable' on the same item from /admin/items.
defense_layers: L1 OrderService::storeOrder (line 404) calls AvailabilityService::assertItemsOrderableForBranch(branchId, requestedItemIds, useRowLock=true) INSIDE the order DB::transaction.
L2 useRowLock=true → SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on item_branch_availability rows — serializes with AvailabilityService::toggle (also lockForUpdate) at MySQL row-level.
L3 If admin's toggle commits FIRST → checkout's locked SELECT sees is_available=false → throws InvalidArgumentException 422 'Article {id} indisponible pour cette branche (out_of_stock).'
L4 If checkout's lock acquires FIRST → admin's toggle blocks on the same row until checkout commits stock_movements + order. Admin then sees the post-checkout state.
L5 absent row = available (V1) — no race because no row to lock = read-only path; admin toggle would INSERT new row only after checkout completes.
6_race_admin_toggle_during_checkout.verdict: RACE PROTECTED. Critical defense already in place — verified by inspection of AvailabilityService.php:253-275 and OrderService.php:404-408. Sentinel: tests/Feature/Order/SubmitRevalidatesChoiceAvailabilityThroughPricingTest.php.

7_multi_admin_simultaneous_toggle.scenario: Two admins click 'set unavailable' on same item simultaneously (different reasons).
behavior: Both transactions begin, both try lockForUpdate on item_branch_availability(item,branch) row.
MySQL grants exclusive row lock to one transaction; the second blocks until the first commits.
After commit: second admin's transaction reads NEW state. Idempotent check (AvailabilityService.php:73): `if (is_available === requested && reason === currentReason) return without dispatch`.
If reasons differ → second admin overwrites reason. ItemAvailabilityChanged event fires AGAIN with the second reason.
Both events ride through outbox → both broadcast → POS/Kiosk shows last broadcast = last writer.
7_multi_admin_simultaneous_toggle.verdict: LAST-WRITE-WINS BY DESIGN. Acceptable for V1 single-restaurant — no concurrent admin scenario realistic. The lockForUpdate prevents lost updates (no torn-write on reason field). DB consistency preserved. Documented invariant.
7_multi_admin_simultaneous_toggle.v1_0_2_risk: If V2 SaaS multi-tenant adds two admins per branch, an admin UI 'last update was {timestamp} by {user}' indicator would catch confused-state. Currently not surfaced.

9_echo_down_stale_kiosk_check.scenario: Pusher/Soketi/Reverb down or Echo subscription fails on kiosk. Admin toggles item to 'unavailable'.
backend_path_resilience: AvailabilityService::toggle commits DB row + Cache::forget('kiosk.menu.branch.{id}') — UNCONDITIONAL backend work, NOT dependent on Echo.
Outbox row written regardless of broadcaster status.
Next kiosk REST call to /api/frontend/menu → MenuController::kiosk → Cache::remember('kiosk.menu.branch.{id}', 60s, fn) → cache MISS (just flushed) → fresh DB query → up-to-date payload returned.
kiosk_frontend_fallback: KioskAppComponent.vue:577 — `catch (_) { silent fallback to TTL }` on Echo subscribe failure.
Kiosk menu re-fetches periodically (catalog change notifier) — stale at most until next fetch or until customer adds item.
OrderService::storeOrder revalidates via assertItemsOrderableForBranch — even if kiosk frontend is stale, the SUBMIT will 422-reject the out-of-stock item.
9_echo_down_stale_kiosk_check.worst_case_ux: Customer adds item to cart on stale kiosk view (Echo dead, cache fresh-then-expired). On checkout SUBMIT, server rejects 422 with French message. Frontend displays error. NO order is created with out-of-stock item — NF525-adjacent invariant preserved.
9_echo_down_stale_kiosk_check.verdict: GRACEFUL DEGRADATION CONFIRMED. Echo is a UX latency optimizer, NOT a correctness gate. The defense-in-depth at OrderService::storeOrder closes the hole.

10_owner_impact_customer_orders_oos.scenario: Suppose the stock cascade BROKE — customer succeeds in placing an order for an item that's actually out of stock.
downstream_blast_radius: L1 ASSERTION ORDER-SIDE: OrderService::storeOrder calls assertItemsOrderableForBranch with lockForUpdate=true. To break this, you'd need to bypass this method entirely — there's no env flag, no bypass. So a code regression would have to literally remove the assertion.
L2 STOCK MOVEMENT: StockService::decrementForOrder fires; if on_hand<qty, it throws StockUnavailableException at line 112 → rolls back the order transaction. Order never created.

L3 KDS DISPLAY: If both L1+L2 fail somehow and the order lands, KDS subscribes to ItemAvailabilityChanged so the inflight ticket gets a striped OOS marker (CV1-KDS-INFLIGHT-OOS-MARKER-001) — the chef sees the warning IMMEDIATELY.

L4 OSS DISPLAY: Order goes through normal lifecycle, customer waits, kitchen physically can't fulfill. Refund triggered manually by manager. Refund flow ALREADY clawback loyalty points (J2-HEAL-07 2026-05-24), reverses stock (ReleaseStockOnRefundCreated), and fires OrderPaymentStatusChanged to broadcast refund.
L5 NF525 CHAIN: Even with cancel/refund, fiscal_sequence_no is preserved (no gap), audit_logs chain bit-identical, z_reports unaffected.
actual_owner_impact_if_cascade_breaks: Bad UX: customer charged for item that won't be made → manual refund + apology + customer churn risk.
Operational friction: KDS doesn't show the OOS marker → chef discovers at prep time → calls manager → manual intervention.
NO fiscal impact — NF525 chain holds because every state mutation is durably recorded with HMAC.
NO multi-tenant data leak — branch isolation enforced by global BranchScope on all 20 protected models (User, Order, FrontendOrder, OrderItem, StockLevel, etc.).
NO double-charge — payment_status is independent SSOT, refund is the canonical reversal path.
10_owner_impact_customer_orders_oos.current_state_resilience: Defense-in-depth means a SINGLE broken layer doesn't surface to the customer — TWO independent layers (assertItemsOrderable + stock_movements UNIQUE + cart prune broadcast + KDS inflight marker) would all have to fail simultaneously for a customer to actually receive an OOS-confirmed order. Very low probability.
10_owner_impact_customer_orders_oos.verdict: BLAST RADIUS BOUNDED. Worst realistic outcome = bad UX + manual refund. No fiscal/multi-tenant/security breach.

verdict.narrative: Stock/Availability cascade is production-grade for V1 Le Cayenne LOCAL. Defense-in-depth across 5 cascade steps (DB row lock, idempotent Cache::add, stock_movements UNIQUE, DB::afterCommit, Echo + REST + TTL fallback). I.3 heal cba372066 closes the rename/reprice gap. HEAL-2 NotifyStockLowOnStockLevelChanged is active and plumbed for V1.0.2 threshold UI. Adversarial scenarios 6-10 all resolve safely with no fiscal/security/data impact. Owner impact if cascade hypothetically broke: bounded to bad UX + manual refund — NF525 chain, branch isolation, payment SSOT all independent of this layer.
verdict.comparison_to_prior_audits: Aligns with Wave Polish Final 2026-05-21 finding that Q9-S1 cross-surface sync converged from 0-60s to ~1s empirical. Aligns with V1 sync deep audit Wave L (2026-05-19) closing 11 heals on the broadcast/idempotency cluster.
